subject: Aging Brains Lose the Deep Fluid Waves That Flush Waste During Sleep
script: From Agewell Brief: Aging Brains Lose the Deep Fluid Waves That Flush Waste During Sleep. Simultaneous brain imaging shows older adults lose the neural slow waves and vascular contractions that pump fluid through the brain during deep sleep. During deep non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep, the brain reorganizes its electrical activity into synchronized, low-frequency electrical waves. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
